changes.summary: Draft gap-checkpoint hardening exact-head Test, NEXUS Build Verification, NEXUS Cloud Fallback, and Probe public kline gaps are green; ownership covers checkpoint read through durable data save and cursor commit, with supported POSIX directory-entry fsync. Semantic inspection additionally found that a successful data repair can change the gap set after save while the cursor checkpoint is still persisted against the pre-save gap-set digest.
changes.security_boundary: Issue #230 remains fail-closed: deterministic post-save gap-set transition/remap is not yet specified or regression-tested; safe orphan-lock recovery, Windows/every-filesystem directory-entry crash durability, adversarial alternate-path/lock bypass replay, and independent policy/test co-weakening evidence also remain incomplete. Green CI on this head is therefore not merge authority.
